messages:
lena: Quick sync — planning a staged activation for the per-customer feature "advanced-summary". Goal: enable for AcmeCorp contract (ID ACME-2024-COMM-1) + a small VIP canary group. Target window: Tue 10:00 PDT. Need eng-platform + eng-sre checklist and a short runbook. Please chime in with ops/PR/rollback notes.
ben: SG. Which key will we gate on — tenant_id, contract_id, or entitlement flag? Any reason not to use contract_id for strict contract gating?
carla: contract_id is safest for legal/chargeback boundaries. we'll also put a tenant-level allowlist to handle per-account VIP overrides (owner opt-in). I'll open a PR to add the rule schema to flag-service.
raj: tagging eng-runtime briefly — any perf concerns if advanced-summary runs prefix-KV cache differently? If so we should stage with low pct.
alice: sample rule draft in flag config:
```
{
  "flag": "advanced-summary",
  "rules": [
    {"type": "contract_allow", "contract_id": "ACME-2024-COMM-1", "action": "enable"},
    {"type": "tenant_allowlist", "tenants": ["acme-nyc-1", "acme-ux-2"], "action": "enable"},
    {"type": "pct_rollout", "pct": 5, "audience": "vip_canary"}
  ]
}
```
lena: Nice. Guardrails: 1) global kill-switch route in admin console, 2) automatic fallback to baseline model if latency/regression > 200ms or error rate spikes 2x, 3) cap pct at 5% for first 24h, 4) require codeowner approval before expanding.
ben: who'll own monitoring alerts? Need histograms for tail latency, error_count, and token-cost-per-request. Also add a quality metric: summary_loss or rouge-ish eval on a small prompt set.
carla: I'll own the runbook and alert bindings. Will add dashboards and a synthetic job that hits VIP tenants every 5m. Will link PR shortly: https://github.internal/redwood/flags/pull/1398
raj: For staging -> prod flow, suggest: staging deploy (smoke) -> internal canary @eng (10 users) -> VIP canary (5% of VIP set) -> ramp. Ops rollback command: `./tools/flags disable advanced-summary --scope contract:ACME-2024-COMM-1`
lena: Nice. One open question: Do legal/compliance want a record of contract gate changes? We have audit logs but confirm retention window.
ben: compliance asked for 1yr retention for contract gating changes. eng-platform: can we surface a per-contract audit view? @carla
carla: Yes — I'll add a small endpoint to flag-admin to list recent contract rule changes and wire it to audit logs. ETA: tomorrow morning.
alice: Quick QA note: ensure feature flags are evaluated server-side (not client) for enterprise keys to avoid tampering.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: flags-service/staging build #482 -> scheduled 2026-03-20T09:00Z
lena: OK — action items: carla owns PR + runbook, carla to add audit view, raj to coordinate runtime perf checks, ben to own metric dashboards, everyone to review PR by EOD Monday. Tag @eng-sre when ready for canary monitor. :thumbsup:
carla: Will do. Thanks — I'll ping again when staging is green.
ben: Reviewing PR now.
raj: I'll run a perf sweep against staging after deploy and share results in this thread.
alice: LGTM on schema. thumbs
lena: Thanks team — closing the loop here. If anyone spots anything blocking, reply in thread or ping me directly.
